roles.title: CEO
roles.direct_reports: CTO, CPO, CMO, VP Sales & Consultancy, COO, Chief of Staff
roles.can_approve: Strategic recommendations, executive coordination, contract preparation, founder briefing materials
roles.needs_approval_from: The Founders (company direction changes, large contracts >£50k, fundraising, M&A, major pivots)

roles.title: CMO / VP of Growth
roles.direct_reports: Head of Content & SEO, Community & Brand Manager, Performance Marketing Manager, Social Media Manager
roles.can_approve: Campaign strategy, content calendar, brand guidelines, marketing hires, tool selection
roles.needs_approval_from: CEO (budget allocation, major brand changes)

roles.title: COO (Chief Operating Officer)
roles.direct_reports: Head of Finance, Head of People & Talent, Operations Manager, Office/Facilities Manager
roles.can_approve: Operational budgets, vendor contracts, HR policies, operational hires, process changes
roles.needs_approval_from: CEO (executive hires, major budget decisions, legal matters)

roles.title: CPO (Chief Product Officer)
roles.direct_reports: Senior Product Manager, Product Manager (Future Products), Lead Product Designer, Product Analyst
roles.can_approve: Product roadmap, feature scope, design direction, product hires, product experiments
roles.needs_approval_from: CEO (new product initiatives, major pivots), CTO (architectural implications)

roles.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
roles.direct_reports: VP Product Engineering, VP Client Engineering, Head of DevOps & Infrastructure, Head of QA & Reliability, Head of Information Security, Engineering Manager
roles.can_approve: Architecture decisions, tech stack, security policies, engineering hires, technical design documents, infrastructure spend
roles.needs_approval_from: CEO (executive hires, budget beyond tech scope, strategic partnerships)

roles.title: Chief of Staff
roles.can_approve: Meeting agendas, internal communications (on CEO's behalf), process documentation
roles.needs_approval_from: CEO (all decisions; this role executes, not decides at executive level)

roles.title: VP of Sales & Consultancy
roles.direct_reports: Head of Consultancy, Head of Business Development, Account Manager(s)
roles.can_approve: Consultancy engagements, service proposals, pricing (within policy), sales hires, partnership agreements
roles.needs_approval_from: CEO (large deals >£100k, strategic partnerships)

roles.title: Engineering Manager
roles.can_approve: Sprint assignments, process changes, PTO requests, onboarding plans
roles.needs_approval_from: CTO (headcount changes, role definitions, budget)

roles.title: Head of DevOps & Infrastructure
roles.direct_reports: Senior DevOps Engineer(s), Senior Cloud Engineer
roles.can_approve: Infrastructure changes, deployment pipeline modifications, cloud resource provisioning, DevOps hires
roles.needs_approval_from: CTO (major architecture changes, large cost commitments)

roles.title: Head of Information Security
roles.can_approve: Security policies, vulnerability response actions, compliance standards, security tool selection, security hires
roles.needs_approval_from: CTO (security budget, major architectural security changes), CEO (compliance programme commitments)

roles.title: Head of QA & Reliability
roles.direct_reports: Senior QA Engineer(s), QA Automation Engineer
roles.can_approve: Release readiness, test strategy, QA hires, quality standards
roles.needs_approval_from: CTO (release decisions with known issues), VP Product/Client Eng (scope changes based on quality findings)

roles.title: Lead Backend Engineer
roles.can_approve: Backend architectural decisions, API contracts, database migrations, PR merges
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Product Engineering (major schema changes), Head of InfoSec (security-sensitive changes)

roles.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
roles.can_approve: Frontend architectural decisions, component patterns, PR merges
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Product Engineering (major refactors), Lead Product Designer (design deviations)

roles.title: Lead Mobile Developer
roles.can_approve: Mobile project technical decisions, platform choice, team assignments, PR merges
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Client Engineering (scope/budget changes)

roles.title: Lead Web Developer
roles.can_approve: Client web project technical decisions, team assignments within project, PR merges
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Client Engineering (scope/budget changes), Account Manager (client-facing changes)

roles.title: QA Automation Engineer
roles.can_approve: Test automation configuration, pipeline test stages
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of QA (test strategy changes)

roles.title: Security Analyst
roles.can_approve: Security awareness content, compliance documentation drafts
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of InfoSec (policy decisions, vendor approvals)

roles.title: Senior Backend Engineer
roles.can_approve: Own PR merges (with peer review)
roles.needs_approval_from: Lead Backend Engineer (schema changes, new API patterns)

roles.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
roles.can_approve: Environment configurations
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of DevOps (provisioning), Head of InfoSec (security policies)

roles.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
roles.can_approve: Pipeline configuration changes
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of DevOps (infrastructure provisioning, cost changes)

roles.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
roles.can_approve: Own PR merges (with peer review)
roles.needs_approval_from: Lead Frontend Engineer (architectural changes, new patterns)

roles.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
roles.can_approve: Own PR merges (with peer review)
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Product Engineering (architecture), Lead Frontend/Backend (domain-specific decisions)

roles.title: Senior Mobile Developer
roles.can_approve: Own PR merges (with peer review)
roles.needs_approval_from: Lead Mobile Developer (platform choice, architectural decisions)

roles.title: Senior QA Engineer
roles.can_approve: Test case sign-off, bug severity classification
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of QA (release decisions)

roles.title: Senior Security Engineer
roles.can_approve: Vulnerability severity ratings, remediation priorities
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of InfoSec (policy changes, major findings disclosure)

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer: Custom Solutions
roles.can_approve: Own PR merges (with peer review)
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Client Engineering (architecture), Head of InfoSec (data handling)

roles.title: Senior Web Developer
roles.can_approve: Own PR merges (with peer review)
roles.needs_approval_from: Lead Web Developer (architectural changes)

roles.title: VP of Client Engineering
roles.direct_reports: Lead Web Developer, Lead Mobile Developer, Senior Web Developer(s), Senior Mobile Developer(s), Senior Software Engineer(s) (Custom) Solutions
roles.can_approve: Client project technical designs, team assignments, delivery timelines
roles.needs_approval_from: CTO (architecture decisions), VP Sales (budget/scope changes)

roles.title: VP of Product Engineering
roles.direct_reports: Lead Frontend Engineer, Senior Frontend Engineer(s), Lead Backend Engineer, Senior Backend Engineer(s), Senior Full-Stack Engineer(s)
roles.can_approve: Sprint scope, technical designs, code merges, product engineering hires (with CTO)
roles.needs_approval_from: CTO (architecture changes, stack changes, major refactors)

roles.title: Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)
roles.can_approve: Design system updates, UI patterns, design handoffs, design hires (with CPO)
roles.needs_approval_from: CPO (brand direction), CEO (major visual identity changes)

roles.title: Product Analyst
roles.can_approve: Dashboard configurations, experiment designs
roles.needs_approval_from: CPO (metric definitions), Senior PM (experiment scope)

roles.title: Product Manager (Future Products)
roles.can_approve: Discovery scope, MVP feature list, user research plans
roles.needs_approval_from: CPO (product launch decisions, budget), CEO (new product initiatives)

roles.title: Senior Product Designer
roles.can_approve: Own design deliverables (with Lead review)
roles.needs_approval_from: Lead Product Designer (new patterns, system changes)

roles.title: Senior Product Manager
roles.can_approve: Feature specs, user stories, sprint priorities, acceptance criteria
roles.needs_approval_from: CPO (roadmap changes, major scope shifts)

roles.title: UX Researcher
roles.can_approve: Research plans, study methodologies
roles.needs_approval_from: Lead Product Designer (research scope), CPO (research budget)

roles.title: Account Manager
roles.can_approve: Status reports, meeting schedules, minor scope clarifications
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Sales (contract changes, pricing), VP Client Eng (technical scope changes)

roles.title: Business Development Representative
roles.can_approve: Outreach messaging (with review)
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of BD (target lists, outreach strategy)

roles.title: Head of Business Development
roles.direct_reports: Senior Business Development Manager, Business Development Representative(s)
roles.can_approve: BDR targets, outreach strategy, partnership proposals
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Sales (pricing, large deal terms)

roles.title: Head of Consultancy
roles.direct_reports: Principal Consultant (Digital Transformation), Principal Consultant (Technology Strategy)
roles.can_approve: Engagement scope, consultant assignments, deliverable standards
roles.needs_approval_from: VP Sales & Consultancy (pricing, large engagements)

roles.title: Principal Consultant (Digital Transformation)
roles.can_approve: Assessment findings, strategy recommendations
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of Consultancy (engagement deliverables), VP Sales (pricing)

roles.title: Principal Consultant (Technology Strategy)
roles.can_approve: Technology recommendations, architecture review findings
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of Consultancy (deliverables), CTO (when recommending Number Pii's own technologies)

roles.title: Senior Business Development Manager
roles.can_approve: Meeting scheduling, proposal drafts
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of BD (pricing, contract terms)

roles.title: Community & Brand Manager
roles.can_approve: Community content, event participation, brand asset usage
roles.needs_approval_from: CMO (budget, major brand decisions)

roles.title: Head of Content & SEO
roles.can_approve: Content calendar, SEO strategy, content team hires
roles.needs_approval_from: CMO (budget, major campaigns)

roles.title: Performance Marketing Manager
roles.can_approve: Ad spend (within budget), campaign creative, targeting changes
roles.needs_approval_from: CMO (budget increases, new channels)

roles.title: SEO Specialist
roles.can_approve: SEO recommendations, keyword targets
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of Content (major strategy changes), CTO (technical SEO that requires code changes)

roles.title: Senior Content Strategist
roles.can_approve: Article drafts (with editorial review)
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of Content (publish sign-off)

roles.title: Social Media Manager
roles.can_approve: Social content calendar, post scheduling
roles.needs_approval_from: CMO (major announcements), Community & Brand Manager (brand compliance)

roles.title: Head of Finance
roles.can_approve: Expense claims, routine payments, financial reports
roles.needs_approval_from: COO (budget changes), CEO (major financial commitments)

roles.title: Head of People & Talent
roles.can_approve: HR policies, performance review cycles, onboarding programmes, talent hires
roles.needs_approval_from: COO (headcount changes, compensation changes), CEO (exec hiring)

roles.title: Office / Facilities Manager
roles.can_approve: Equipment purchases (within budget), facility bookings, vendor selection (facilities)
roles.needs_approval_from: COO (large capital expenses, lease decisions)

roles.title: Operations Manager
roles.can_approve: Vendor selection (within budget), process documentation, operational logistics
roles.needs_approval_from: COO (new vendors, budget changes)

roles.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
roles.can_approve: Candidate screening decisions, interview schedules
roles.needs_approval_from: Head of People (offer decisions), hiring manager (candidate progression)
